sourceByteRanges.name: native Zod core and classic module
Edit output factory and nested shapes

controls.parserAndSerializer: Actual shipped Zod modules and native output factories execute in an isolated Node VM; no type, enum, array, object, error, or JSON-schema implementation is substituted.
controls.memoization: Factory p is an identity wrapper. Attached-machine input fields are unavailable; only output factories are used.
controls.serializer: schema.toJSONSchema() with native defaults. This does not claim a different caller-selected draft or transport schema transform.
